title: AFTERIMAGE//PULSE
description: DaemonV12 Sound Lab 03, the full-length record: 86 bars, E major, 136 BPM. THRONE//VOLT, Living Bass, Impossible Voice, HEAVEN//MASS, Mechanical Orchestra, Timbre Lab; V12 Signature and GLASSHOUSE drums.

tracks.description: V12 IRON PULSE body + GLASSHOUSE bass-punch knock; follows the bass in the undertow and the finale, every pickup in the cascade.
V12 TITANIUM CRACK +1 st + GLASSHOUSE chrome clap; 5-8 ms late; pushed and dragged backbeats; ghosts.
GLASSHOUSE pixel hat, V12 ghost tick and open circuit; patterns that change with the section; drifting pan.
Timbre Lab hollow log and hand skin (fill, talking drum, heartbeats), escapement clock.
The afterimage: Mechanical Orchestra bar. The opening, the dark return, the memory, the hymn's third voice, the finale, the ending.
Living Bass below 120 Hz: mono, ducked under every kick.
Living Bass above 120 Hz: the talking body, the reply, the melodic bass; saturated for small speakers.
Impossible Voice: two notes of every riff in the undertow, the glitch passage, the last answer before the end.
THRONE//VOLT: the hook dark, talking, at night, singing the reply, at full voice; the cascade and the climb.
THRONE//VOLT pad: the chord bed, breathing with the pulse.
HEAVEN//MASS basses (octavists on the blooms and the landing) and tenors.
HEAVEN//MASS altos and sopranos: the half-speed hook, the hymn in canon, the catching-up echo, the landing, the afterglow.
The shared rack room (wet only) of the lead, pad, bass/voice and percussion scores.
